content:
Leah Kim: Customer Mosaic requested a minimal-ops onprem path: VPC peering + customer-run BGP + exact egress IP preservation. Wants a one-command installer and an operator shim. Can we scope as "beta-by-request" for next quarter?
Omar Rizvi: Agree if it's gating 3 customers. Must include: preflight CIDR overlap checks, explicit egress-preserve mode, and a documented fallback to hosted models.
Tanya Gupta: Proposed delivery split: Phase 1 (shim + CLI + preflight) beta. Phase 2 (full in-place bundle + automated upgrades) stable. Phase1 target: 2-week spike then MLP.
Eli Brooks: CLI UX sketch: `redwood install --mode=byo-net --egress-prefix=198.51.100.0/28 --preserve-egress` -> shows PRECHECKS and requires `--confirm`. Should emit audit event and create `egress-claim` resource.
Leah Kim: Important: define maintenance window (<=3h), and runbook steps for BGP flap: immediate read-only fallback to hosted for 10m, alert NetOps, re-establish, then backfill requests. Add this as console policy toggle.
FieldOpsBot: NOTE: sandbox test requested. Recommend dry-run with BGP simulator + two tenant isolation tests.
Tanya Gupta: Launch gates (draft): 1) Field sign-off from at least one paying customer; 2) Installer preflight pass; 3) Migration dry-run + rollback validated; 4) Runbook + docs + known limitations; 5) Beta billing tag + support playbook.
Omar Rizvi: Risks: overlapping private CIDRs -> need SNAT which can break ACLs upstream. Doc this clearly and add `--snat=preserve|force` flag. Also require explicit opt-in for egress claiming.
DocsBot: Added placeholder: docs/redwood/install/byo-network.md (draft). Please update with CLI examples and troubleshooting.
Leah Kim: Action items: Omar/Tanya/Eli to write a 1-pager with gates, UX, and rollback steps by Wed EOD. FieldOps to schedule a 45m demo next Fri. I'll slot into roadmap planning. :thumbsup:
